scope: One Tower Control Operator role option only. Other roles and later role-specific notices are not extracted.

findings.jobType: NAV Brasil federal public-company CLT employment; 51 immediate Tower Control Operator vacancies in the retified edital role table, plus reserve list.
findings.application: Retified edital section 4.1: 27 April 2026 16:00 through 28 May 2026 18:00 Brasília time. Fee payment deadline 29 May 2026 23:59 is separate.
findings.internationalApplicants: Registration section requires CPF but does not clearly settle foreign-citizen access. Before training, section 14.3.1 requires Brazilian or Portuguese nationality; Portuguese nationals need recognized Equality Statute status with political rights. Appointment section 19.1(a) repeats condition. Other nationalities fail published later-stage rule; Portuguese eligibility stays conditional.
findings.language: Section 9.3 includes 10 Portuguese and 20 English objective questions for secondary-level Tower Control role. Second amendment revises English syllabus. Neither document gives CEFR or separate required proficiency level.
findings.venue: Retified edital section 2.3 names 11 objective-exam cities. Pins are city precision; airport work-placement cities are not exam centres.
findings.amendments: Employer and FGV organizer registers each list first and second retifications. New amendment rows or changed PDF bytes block the connector. Later convocation/result notices require founder review.
